progression_balancing.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

accessibility.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Items:** ensure all logically relevant items can be acquired. Some items, such as keys, may be self-locking, and some locations may be inaccessible.

game_mode.description: Choose Classic or Steel Soul. Steel Soul changes some checks and ends the save on death.

goal.description: Act 1-3 require beating the chosen act, Cursed Ending is self explanatory, Flea Hunt is getting the set amount of fleas and Spelling Bee is getting every unique letter in the chosen phrase with Alphabet Rando on.

spelling_bee_phrase.description:
The word or phrase used by the Spelling Bee goal.

A-Z letters, spaces, commas, periods, question marks and exclamation marks are supported. At least one letter is required. Other characters change the goal to Act 2 and do not automatically enable Alphabet Mode.

flea_hunt_count.description: Number of distinct AP Fleas received for Flea Hunt victory.

starting_location.description:
Choose your starting location and F4 destination. Alternate starts have a checkpoint immediately. Bone Bottom's F4 warp unlocks after visiting.

Songclave requires an Act 2 or later goal. Randomized Ledge Grab replaces Vanilla with Bone Bottom.

entrance_randomization.description: EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE. Couple room exits with matching directions.

entrance_randomization_scope.description: Choose the coupled entrance pool. Full shuffles all supported connections. Interiors shuffles door/interior pairs. Within Areas shuffles connections inside each area and leaves area boundaries unchanged.

starting_crest.description:
Choose Hornet's starting Crest when Crests are randomized.

random selects one of the seven Crests.

force_naked.description: Start cloakless without a Crest until you find one. Overrides Starting Crest. Experimental. Requires Crest Randomization set to anywhere.

early_sprint.description: Place sprint early when Skills are randomized. With Split Dash And Sprint enabled, only the first Progressive Swift Step is placed early. Otherwise, the early Swift Step also grants dash.

silk_and_soul_points.description: Wish points required for Silk and Soul for the Act 3 goal. Other goals keep the vanilla 17-point requirement. Mandatory wishes and story requirements remain unchanged. Nuu's wish does not count in logic. Values above 23 are treated as 23, or 22 in Steel Soul.

ledgegrab_ability_rando.description: Randomizes Hornet's ability to grab ledges.

directional_ledge_grab.description: Split Ledge Grab into Left and Right items. Automatically enables Ledge Grab Rando.

bind_randomization.description: Randomizes Bind for healing, heal stalls and interactions that require it. Shared adds one Bind item for every crest. Per Crest adds a Bind item for each crest.

directional_cling_grip.description: Split Cling Grip into Left and Right wall-clinging items with Skills set to anywhere.

directional_swift_step.description: Split Swift Step into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere. Each item grants dash and sprint only in its direction. With Split Dash And Sprint enabled, three Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint in both directions first, then one dash direction chosen by the seed, then the other direction.

directional_clawline.description: Split Clawline into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere.

split_dash_and_sprint.description: With Skills set to anywhere, the first Progressive Swift Step grants sprint and the second grants dash. With Directional Swift Step enabled, three Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint, one dash direction chosen by the seed then the other dash direction.

trails_end_requirement.description: Choose whether Trail's End uses 14 Shakra map-stock purchases or received maps.

enemy_pogo_logic.description:
Use enemy pogo tricks to gain height or cross gaps beyond ordinary traversal.

Normal enemy pogos remain available with this option set to None.

Higher settings also allow easier tricks.

proficient_combat.description:
Choose the preferred combat requirements settings.

Off: use the normal combat requirements. Goated: lower Needle, DPS and Crafting Kit requirements by one tier and Mask Shard requirements by four fragments. Hell: bypass combat requirements including combat movement.

damage_boost_logic.description: Take a hit to cross an obstacle using knockback or invulnerability. None disables these routes. Higher settings also allow easier boosts.

platforming_capability.description: Normal uses ordinary platforming routes. Proficient Movement allows precise inputs and advanced uses of movement abilities. Elite Ball Knowledge also includes routes marked for that setting.

flea_brew_jump_logic.description:
Use Flea Brew's movement speed boost to make longer jumps.

Its speed boost for the Weavenest Cindril secret room remains in logic with this option disabled.

Requires Flea Brew and a crest with a usable red tool slot.

red_tool_stall_logic.description:
Use Flea Brew, Flintslate, Plasmium Phial or Voltvessels in midair to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

drill_crystal_pogo_logic.description:
Take damage to create a Memory Crystal, then use Delver's Drill to gain height from it. Both tools must fit on the same owned crest.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

crest_pogo_logic.description:
Use crest-specific pogo techniques to gain height or extend jumps. Covers pogo skips for every crest.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

needle_strike_logic.description:
Use Needle Strike stalls and crest-specific charged attacks to delay your fall, extend jumps or gain height.

None disables these techniques.

Higher settings also allow easier uses.

sharpdart_logic.description:
Use Sharpdart to cross gaps and extend jumps.

When disabled, traversal never requires Sharpdart.

scuttlebrace_logic.description:
Use Scuttlebrace dodges to extend jumps and reach ledges.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

heal_stall_logic.description:
Start binding in midair to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

hazard_respawn_logic.description:
Deliberately touch a hazard to return to a useful respawn point, allowing shortcuts across gaps or obstacles.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

start_fully_mapped.description: Start with the full world map drawn, regardless of map ownership. This does not grant map items. Use Start With Maps to receive them.

automatic_compass.description: Always show Hornet on maps without granting or equipping Compass.

randomized_bell_markers.description: Show map markers for your Grand Gate Bells where the randomizer placed them in your world.

randomized_melody_markers.description: Show map markers for your Threefold Melody pieces where the randomizer placed them in your world.

vog_area_hints.description: Number of area reports Vog can sell. Reports count remaining progression items for any player without revealing their names and update as you complete checks.

bellway_access.description: Choose whether Bell Beast must be defeated before using Bellways.

enemy_rosary_multiplier.description: Multiply Rosaries dropped by defeated enemies only.

enemy_shard_multiplier.description: Multiply Shell Shards dropped by defeated enemies only.

bellway_prices.description: Randomize prices charged by Bellway toll machines.

ventrica_prices.description: Randomize prices charged by Ventrica toll machines.

map_prices.description: Randomize prices for Shakra's area maps and Citadel map machines.

pin_prices.description: Randomize prices for Shakra's permanent map pins.

upgrade_prices.description: Randomize the two paid Needle-upgrade service prices.

donation_prices.description: Randomize Rosary and Shell Shard Wish donation requirements.

vog_hint_prices.description: Randomize the price of Vog's area reports.

faster_dialogue.description: Speed up ordinary NPC dialogue without skipping conversations.

faster_silkheart_animation.description:

False keeps the vanilla pickup animation but skips the dream sequence.

quill_randomization.description:
Keep Quill at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Skill Randomization. Start Fully Mapped removes the need for Quill.

compass_randomization.description:
Keep Compass at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Tool Randomization. Automatic Compass supplies the position marker without the tool.

old_heart_randomization.description: Randomizes Pollen Heart, Hunter's Heart, Encrusted Heart and Conjoined Heart for the Act 3 goal.

everbloom_randomization.description: Randomizes Everbloom for Act 3 goals. The final Abyss route still requires the three-heart ritual and Red Memory to be completed.

memento_randomization.description: Randomizes Mementos available for your goal. Hunter's Memento stays vanilla. Hearts follow Old Heart Randomization.

materium_randomization.description: Randomizes Materium, Flintstone, Magnetite and Voltridian.

bellhome_randomization.description: Randomizes Desk, Gleamlights, Bell Lacquer, Personal Spa, Gramophone and Crawbell. Crawbell is only included for Act 3 goals.

silk_heart_logic.description:
Places logical routes for abilities that require silk behind the acquisition of at least one Silk Heart. These include Needolin, Clawline and Silk Soar.

Turning this option off may cause more frequent soft locks as you may get stuck in a location where you can't get more silk.

boss_souls.description: Randomize Boss Souls into the item pool. Bosses do not spawn and their respective arenas are not available until their "soul" has been collected. Bosses that have a gauntlet attached to them are the sole requirement for the gauntlet's spawn. Example: Groal's Soul makes his boss fight available and the Bilehaven gauntlet available as well.

npc_souls.description: Randomize NPC Souls into the item pool. NPCs do not spawn until their respective soul has been collected.

enemy_souls.description: Randomize Enemy Souls into the item pool. Enemies do not spawn and their respective gauntlets are not available until their "soul" has been collected. Bosses and boss gauntlets are affected by the boss souls option. Killing an enemy for the first time grants a check.

boss_sanity.description:
Adds boss checks and replaces their filler with boss credit items. Receiving a credit grants that boss's story unlocks. Items dropped by bosses follow their own randomization settings.

Fight difficulty and arena exits stay with the boss you face. Act transitions still require their original fights.

false: keeps the usual boss progression without extra checks true: boss credits can appear anywhere in the multiworld

journal_randomization.description:
Randomizes the Hunter's Journal and boss journal entries. Entries that need multiple kills have separate completion checks and items.

false: keeps the usual journal true: mixes journal items into the multiworld

wish_sanity.description:
Adds completion checks for wishes without a separately randomized item reward. Items earned from bosses and wishes follow their own randomization settings.

false: no additional wish completion checks true: fills wish completion checks from the global item pool

shuffle_wish_offers.description:
EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE, should be fine but please don't bring to syncs

Shuffles supported wishes between boards and NPCs independently of Wish Completion Checks. Each wish keeps its tasks and story effects. Linked NPC follow-ups stay with their original NPCs.

wish_plando.description: Fix which wish an offer gives. Requires Shuffle Wish Offers. Use wish names, with the original offer on the left and the wanted wish on the right. Example: {"Wish: Berry Picking": "Wish: Final Audience"} The remaining offers are shuffled. Assignments that block progression are rejected.

individual_relic_turn_ins.description: Make Scrounge's 15 relic and Cardinius's 6 cylinder deposits individual AP checks instead of paying Rosaries.

silk_link.description: Share only the base Spool's current Silk with other enabled Silksong players.

rosary_link.description: Share loose Rosary gains and costs with other enabled Silksong players.

shell_shard_link.description: Share base-pouch Shell Shard gains and costs with enabled Silksong players.

knockback_link.description:
Share hit and Stagger Trap knockback with other enabled players.

Incoming impacts use their direction at normal Stagger Trap strength.

alphabet_mode.description:
Add Letter A through Letter Z to the item pool and hide unowned letters in game text.

Text filtering only runs while the game language is English. This needs at least 26 randomized filler rewards.

trap_disguises.description:
Disguise traps as major items in shops, wishes and crest slots.

Shop and wish icons are mirrored. Shop and crest-slot names contain small typos.

trap_percentage.description:
Percent of eligible filler items in the random pool replaced by traps.

If every trap weight is zero, no traps are added.

stagger_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Stagger Traps, zero disables them.

When staggered, Hornet receives knockback but takes no damage.

rosary_spill_trap_weight.description: Relative frequency of Rosary Spill Traps, zero disables them.

darkness_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Darkness Traps, zero disables them.

The screen is darkened to a small area of light around Hornet for 20 seconds.

cursed_crest_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Cursed Crest Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is inflicted with the Cursed Crest for 90 seconds, as if she had done the Rite of Rebirth quest with Greyroot.

muckmaggot_status_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Muckmaggot Status Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is afflicted with Muckmaggots as if she fell into Bilewater. Binding or using a bench removes them.

naked_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of 90-second Naked Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is left naked as if she were in the Slab escape sequence for 90 seconds.

literacy_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Literacy Traps, zero disables them.

Interrupts with a randomly selected passage of pre-written text. Advance each dialogue box to regain control while the action continues around you.

shader_trap_weight.description:
Relative frequency of Shader Traps, zero disables them.

Applies a shader to the game camera with the potential shaders: Oil Painting, Grayscale
